This is a personal fork of [buzkall/fromscratch](https://github.com/buzkall/fromscratch), itself a
fork of [Kilian/fromscratch](https://github.com/Kilian/fromscratch). It is maintained for its
author's own use, with no promise of support or response.

Before opening an issue, please check which project it belongs to:

- **The app's behaviour, features or editing** — these come from the original. Try
  [Kilian/fromscratch](https://github.com/Kilian/fromscratch/issues) first.
- **Build tooling, Electron 43, React 19 or CodeMirror 6** — inherited from
  [buzkall/fromscratch](https://github.com/buzkall/fromscratch/issues).
- **The app icon, the macOS build workflow, or the release dmgs** — those are specific to this fork,
  and belong here.

Downloaded builds are unsigned, so macOS blocks them on first launch. That is expected, not a bug:
allow the app under System Settings → Privacy & Security, then press Open Anyway. See the README.
